wave_qa.review_scope: Independent targeted QA of waving contour correction; existing other rows checked on atlas overview and verified pixel-identical. No new direction-semantic certification.
wave_qa.review_method: Visual inspection of enlarged before/after crops, all four native animation frames decoded from waving-after.webp in chronological order 0,1,2,3,0 on light/dark backgrounds at 192 and 96 pixel widths, and atlas contact sheet. Static sequential review, not live client playback.
findings: All four repaired frames read as a continuous brown sleeve contour from cuff through midarm to shoulder/elbow; the previous narrow middle followed by conspicuously heavy elbow is sufficiently resolved at both 192 and 96 pixel display widths.

The approved broad sleeve silhouette, paw size, cuff position, arm length and raised-arm pose remain visually unchanged in the before/after comparisons. The arm still reads as the same approved width.
No new visible seam, doubled contour, isolated speckle or objectionable jagged edge appears at native or half size on either background.
The mint fabric and warm brown outline remain perceptually matched to the original. Changes are localized to outline masks; this is not a claim that every mint-edge antialias pixel is identical.
Chronological inspection of frames 0,1,2,3 and the 3-to-0 wrap shows stable line weight without a conspicuous contour pop. Paw motion and timing remain the original small wave.

Independent decoded RGBA comparison confirms exactly four changed cells (row 3, columns 0-3), 84 completely unchanged cells, whole-atlas alpha equality, and zero changed pixels outside the provided local masks.

All four animated preview frames match the corresponding final atlas cells byte-for-byte after RGBA decoding; PNG and WebP atlas pixels also match. Validation and frame inspection report no errors or warnings.
